burner_tagger: Marks a target so the rest of the Kiln knows where to aim.
kiln_enforcer: Collects debts for the Kiln. Accepts payment in hardware or in ash.
furnace_hulk: A loading rig with the safety governor burned out on purpose.
pyre_warlord: Believes any system worth owning is worth burning down first.
flux_courier: Carries what the Brokers won't put on a wire. Never the same route twice.
broker_guard: Paid well enough to be polite and well enough not to be bribed.
data_leviathan: A whole exchange's order flow, swimming in one direction.
ledger_warden: Knows what you owe before you've borrowed it.
vat_grub: Clinic waste that learned to crawl toward warmth.
clinic_orderly: Keeps the patients calm and the visitors brief.
flesh_golem: Assembled from spare tissue and a consent form nobody signed.
gene_surgeon: Edits you while you're still arguing.
null_flicker: There for one frame in three. Aim for the other two.
cell_eraser: Doesn't delete files. Deletes the fact that there were files.
void_maw: A hole in the address space with an appetite.
zero_prophet: Preaches that the cleanest system is an empty one.
sentry_drone: The Hive's eyes. Where one looks, twelve arrive.
plated_guard: More armour than person, by weight and by choice.
riot_mech: Built for crowd control. It counts you as a crowd.
hive_controller: Flies forty drones with one hand and files reports with the other.
pirate_jammer: Drowns your signal in someone else's mixtape.
shock_jock: Talks until your Firewall gives up out of embarrassment.
signal_tower: Channel 99's voice carries because this thing never sleeps.
the_anchor: Reads the news of your defeat a few seconds before it happens.
kiln_mother: She lit the first furnace and has kept every one since.
furnace_king: Wears the Kiln's heat like a crown and shares it freely.
undertow_broker: Has shorted every Ghost who came through this door, and collected.
tidal_exchange: A market that never closes and never loses.
chief_surgeon: Thinks of this fight as elective surgery. Yours.
gene_saint: The Clinic's proof of concept, canonised by the people it rewrote.
zero_prime: The first cell. Every erasure since has been a copy of its work.
the_absence: Reports describe it by listing what was no longer there.
hive_overseer: Every drone's camera feed, watched at once, without blinking.
chrome_queen: The swarm isn't hers. The swarm is her.
dj_feedback: Turns your own traffic into the drop.
the_broadcast: You can't block it. You can only decide how loudly you hear it.
ash_runner: Fast enough to outrun its own fire, most days.
ember_marshal: Drills the Kiln's crews until burning in formation feels natural.
kiln_heart: The furnace under all the other furnaces.
margin_agent: Calls in your collateral mid-fight. You are the collateral.
deep_ledger: The book the Brokers don't show the auditors.
riptide_auditor: Finds the discrepancy. Becomes the discrepancy's last problem.
drowned_market: Every trade that ever went under, still open, still hungry.
spore_nurse: Checks your vitals and adjusts them without asking.
head_geneticist: Has a version of you on file that behaves better.
mother_vat: Everything Wetware ever grew, it grew first.
blank: A face-shaped gap in the security footage.
event_horizon: Data that crosses it is still falling.
null_cardinal: Ordains erasures and keeps the only record, in its head.
zero_point: Where Cell Zero's doctrine stops being a metaphor.
strike_drone: The Hive's answer to any question, delivered from above.
siege_walker: Designed to open buildings. Networks turned out to be easier.
swarm_admiral: Fights the way a tide comes in: everywhere at once.
hive_throne: The seat the whole swarm kneels toward.
feedback_loop: Gets louder every time you hit it, which was your first mistake.
speaker_stack: A wall of sound, and behind it another wall.
the_headliner: Everyone before it was the opening act.
dead_air: The silence after the last station signs off, and it's coming for yours.
storm_harpy: Rides the interference between towers and dives when your signal drops.
rust_sentinel: Decommissioned twice. Reported for duty both times.
void_tick: Feeds on unused memory. Yours counts.
ash_shaman: Reads burnt logs like tea leaves and is right too often.
mire_beast: What collects at the bottom of a data lake nobody drains.
reaver: Strips rigs for parts while their owners are still jacked in.
chorus_of_echoes: A thousand recorded voices agreeing with each other, loudly.
warden_construct: Security you can lease by the hour. Somebody paid for the whole night.
the_unwritten: A place the search engines refused to index, and it took that personally.
storm_regent: It was built to supervise. It decided everything needed supervising.
cinder_mite: Stray sparks of someone else's heat sink. Alone they sting. In a cluster they cook.
hollow_wisp: A packet that lost its header and never stopped travelling.
ember_imp: Burner test code that escaped the lab and learned to enjoy itself.
bramble_crawler: Perimeter wire that got tired of waiting for intruders and went looking.
tide_lurker: It sits in the stream and waits for traffic that looks tired.
spore_pod: One message, sent ten thousand times, with teeth.
shard_golem: A firewall that shattered once and reassembled itself angrier.
hex_knight: Old corporate honour guard. Still salutes a logo nobody remembers.
brood_mother: Every machine she touches becomes one of her children.
hollow_monarch: The account was closed years ago. The permissions never were.
cinder_colossus: The arcology's boiler room, given a grudge and legs.
glass_wraith: The reflection of a Ghost who never jacked out.
black_ice: The reason older Ghosts tell you not to go this deep.
worm_larva: Small enough to ignore, which is the whole strategy.
orphan_daemon: Its parent process died. It kept the job and lost the limits.
deadman_switch: It doesn't need to win. It only needs to be holding the button.
archivist: Forgets nothing, forgives nothing, and files you under 'pending'.
kill_switch: The last line of a contract, enforced.
worm_queen: Every worm in the Stack is a letter she wrote home.
root_kernel: Everything in the Stack runs on its permission. It has never once said yes.
last_mirror: It shows you the run you should have made.
